title: Terms on the Rate at Which Controls Upgrade Hours Are Priced Where the Building Also Holds Maintenance Cover
content:
# Terms on the Rate at Which Controls Upgrade Hours Are Priced Where the Building Also Holds Maintenance Cover

**Term 1.** Where the building carries a maintenance agreement standing active whose tier covers repair labor and the twelve months to the handling day carry at least one support ticket closed on site, the upgrade hours of the plan under the Building Automation Service Plans are priced at that maintenance agreement's own regular-hours labor rate.

**Term 2.** Where the building carries a maintenance agreement standing active whose tier does not cover repair labor and the twelve months to the handling day carry at least one support ticket closed on site, the hours are priced at the tier's on-site controls technician rate less eight per cent, taken to two decimal places.

**Term 3.** In every other case the hours are priced at the tier's on-site controls technician rate.

The agreement, its standing, whether its tier covers repair labor and its own regular-hours labor rate are read from the office's records of Preventive Maintenance Agreements written against that building.

| Maintenance agreement at the building standing active | That agreement's tier covers repair labor | Support tickets closed on site in the twelve months | Rate the hours are priced at |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | at least 1 | that maintenance agreement's own regular-hours labor rate |
| yes | no | at least 1 | the tier's on-site controls technician rate less 8 per cent |
| yes | either | none | the tier's on-site controls technician rate |
| no | not read | any | the tier's on-site controls technician rate |

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

At a plan tier whose on-site controls technician rate is 156 USD an hour, a building carrying an agreement under the Preventive Maintenance Agreements standing active whose tier does not cover repair labor, with 2 support tickets closed on site in the twelve months, prices the hours at 156 USD less 8 per cent, that is 143.52 USD an hour. Where that agreement's tier covers repair labor and its own regular-hours labor rate is 138 USD, the hours are priced at 138 USD an hour. With no support ticket closed on site in the twelve months, they are priced at 156 USD an hour.
